label: A necessary intermediary can directly supply every actual contingent recipient
paraphrase: On the existing chainG profile at false, d is an actual root and directly grounds the necessary g. The actual c is contingent. With only g selected by the naming predicate, universal finite ancestral reach to all actual concreta fails. This interpretation tests a proposed restriction on the recipients.
